title: Add 'Add to Cart' Button on Product Listing Page
source: Direct input - Shopping cart feature implementation

user_story.action: click an 'Add to Cart' button directly on the product listing page
user_story.benefit: add items to shopping cart quickly without needing to open each product's details page

acceptance_criteria.title: Button Visibility
acceptance_criteria.description: An 'Add to Cart' button must be displayed on every product card in the product listing/catalog view.

acceptance_criteria.title: Action & Feedback - Item Added
acceptance_criteria.description: When clicked, the item is successfully added to the user's shopping cart.
acceptance_criteria.details: Visual indicator (e.g., toast notification 'Item added to cart!' or button state change to 'Added ✓') shown to user

acceptance_criteria.title: Real-time Cart Counter Update
acceptance_criteria.description: The cart icon counter in the website header updates dynamically in real-time to reflect the new item count.

acceptance_criteria.title: Inventory Handling
acceptance_criteria.description: If a product is out of stock, the button should be disabled and labeled as 'Out of Stock'.

acceptance_criteria.title: Guest Users - Local Storage
acceptance_criteria.description: For guest users, cart items must be stored in local storage/session storage.

acceptance_criteria.title: Logged-in Users - Backend Sync
acceptance_criteria.description: For logged-in users, cart items must sync with the backend database.

technical_requirements.integration: Must integrate with existing cart API endpoint
technical_requirements.storage_options: LocalStorage/SessionStorage for guests, Database for logged-in users

definition_of_done: Unit tests written for UI component states (In stock, Out of stock, Success state)
Toast notification component implemented and tested
Cart counter header component updates dynamically
Local storage implementation for guest users
Backend database sync for logged-in users
Tested on desktop and mobile responsive views
business_value: Improves user experience by reducing friction in the shopping workflow. Enables quick cart additions without page navigation.

in_scope: Add to Cart button UI component
